title: OAuth client-secret rotation leaves autoscaled pods on the revoked secret
source_note: Failure pattern (a scheduled credential rotation where the old secret is revoked before a subset of consumers picks up the new one, so those consumers get authentication failures) reflects credential-management guidance in the AWS Builders' Library. All services, log lines, metrics, and timestamps are fabricated for evaluation.
incident_report: Since ~14:02 UTC about 30% of partner API calls are failing authentication. The rest succeed. No application deploys. The identity team did a scheduled secret rotation at 14:00.

signal_lines.msg: scheduled rotation of the client secret for 'partner-api-gateway' completed; old secret revoked
token request to identity-provider returning 401 invalid_client on some pods
~30% of partner API calls failing auth; affected pods started after 13:40 with a stale config
config map version skew: newer pods hold the pre-rotation client secret
rolled the deployment to force fresh config on all pods; auth failures cleared

ground_truth.root_cause: The OAuth client secret that partner-api-gateway uses to authenticate to the internal identity provider was rotated on schedule and the old secret was revoked. The new secret was in place at the identity provider, but a subset of partner-api-gateway pods - those that autoscaled up after ~13:40 from a stale config map - came up holding the pre-rotation secret. Those pods' token requests returned '401 invalid_client', failing ~30% of partner API calls. The rotation itself was fine; the failure is a config-propagation gap that left some pods on the revoked secret. Recovery required rolling the deployment to force fresh config onto all pods.
evidence_path: identity-provider INFO at 14:00: scheduled client-secret rotation for partner-api-gateway completed, old secret revoked
partner-api-gateway ERROR: token requests returning 401 invalid_client on some pods
the affected pods all started after 13:40 with a stale config map holding the pre-rotation secret
auth_failure_rate rises to ~30%, matching the fraction of stale pods
auth failures clear after the deployment is rolled to force fresh config on all pods
ground_truth.fix: Roll the deployment to refresh config on all pods (done). Make rotation wait for confirmed propagation to 100% of consumers before revoking the old secret, keep a short window where both secrets are valid, and have pods fail startup if their config is older than the current secret generation.
